items.title: FRC launches reviews into pension illustration assumptions and standards
items.summary: The Financial Reporting Council has initiated a call for feedback and a discussion paper on actuarial standards for pension illustrations.

items.title: Novel secures equity investment from Crestview Partners
items.summary: Novel Financial Holdings has received an investment from Crestview Partners to support its underwriting and insurance services expansion.

items.title: Government proposes guided retirement scheme for private sector workers
items.summary: Ministers have proposed a default guided retirement option intended to offer millions of private sector workers a guaranteed income for life.

items.title: Quilter Investors CIO Marcus Brookes assumes Cirilium portfolio management
items.summary: Quilter Investors Chief Investment Officer Marcus Brookes takes over portfolio management duties for the firm's Cirilium portfolios following a period of underperformance and Assessment of Value red flags.

items.title: Miller appoints Peter Stubbings as CEO of Reinsurance and Gary Masters as Chairman
items.summary: Independent specialist insurance and reinsurance broker Miller names Peter Stubbings as CEO of Reinsurance and Gary Masters as Chairman.

items.title: Barclays becomes first major lender to offer early payouts for car finance mis-selling
items.summary: Barclays Partner Finance is contacting tens of thousands of complaining customers with early settlement offers ahead of a crucial industry legal battle.
